entries.zh: 劝告；教导（aconsejar：以教示二字对译，劝诫之意）
entries.en: to advise; to counsel, instruct

entries.zh: 好好劝导、有分寸地劝（款曲：殷勤委婉地劝勉）
entries.en: to advise well, with tact and propriety
entries.notes: 款曲本义委婉周到，展开依赖西语词头推断。

entries.zh: 善意劝化、循规蹈矩地劝（善化）
entries.en: to counsel well and in orderly fashion; to edify

entries.zh: 劝坏、教唆（畔：疑为叛/畔之音写，引向歧途之意）
entries.en: to give bad counsel; to lead astray
entries.notes: 单字畔义不直明，依西语 aconsejar mal 推断。

entries.zh: 父劝其子（主张：拿主意、教导主张）
entries.en: for the father to advise his son (to decide, counsel)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（词头 Acontecer/Acordarse：发生；想起）
entries.en: to happen; to remember (damaged entry)
entries.notes: 汉字与官话栏皆空，仅存闽南 prǔter（疑为 prouter/pronto 类残词）。

entries.zh: 惯（成为习惯）
entries.en: to be accustomed, be in the habit of

entries.zh: 惯于、习以为常（惯荐：荐或为荐举/惯见之用）
entries.en: to make a habit of; accustomed (habitually)
entries.notes: 第二字义待定，依 cuàn chiěn 音与西语惯用义推断。

entries.zh: 惯熟、熟习成惯
entries.en: well accustomed; familiar by habit

entries.zh: 惯世、习于世故（惯世）
entries.en: accustomed to the world; worldly-wise by habit
entries.notes: 惯世搭配不常见，语义由词根推断。

entries.zh: 惯得很、习惯甚深（惯满：满作程度补语）
entries.en: very much accustomed, thoroughly used to
entries.notes: 满作程度补语属推断展开。

entries.zh: 已经惯了（惯了：完成态）
entries.en: already accustomed, now used to it

entries.zh: 自幼操劳成惯、惯于劳苦（操心：操持辛劳）
entries.en: to be habituated to toil from childhood
entries.notes: 操心今义多忧劳，此处依西语 labor/niñez 语境取操持劳作义。

entries.zh: 操练、磨练成惯（操炼）
entries.en: to train, discipline by labor (formed by habit)
entries.notes: quere costumbre 义由操炼之炼取。

entries.zh: 鹞（鹰类小猛禽）
entries.en: sparrowhawk, kestrel (a small hawk)

entries.zh: 打、鞭打（açotar：抽打；闽南取白读 pá）
entries.en: to whip, flog, beat

entries.zh: 打着、鞭打到（打着：打中/挨打）
entries.en: to strike, give a whipping (hit by blows)

entries.zh: 沿街鞭打（打迎街：在街上抽打）
entries.en: to whip along the streets, flog through the streets

entries.zh: 捆打、（对官吏/官长）打一下（綑打）
entries.en: to give the mandarin a stroke of the whip; to strike once
entries.notes: 綑打字面捆绑而打，西语 una vez el mandarin 作打一下解，两解并记。

entries.zh: 管教地打、责打（端打：端正而打，含教诫义）
entries.en: to whip by way of correction, chastise
entries.notes: 端打之义依西语 corrigiendo（以惩戒为目的）推断。
